content: Missing targets lost: Any present code resets the missing status of another requested version; missing bare/fullwidth code also relaxes outside intended targets. Real PG reproductions saved.
Document predicate broadened: Expansion drops version/all-code/name constraints and workspace, producing both years or the entire corpus while claiming complete.
Publish lacks closing source guard: Derivation source change still publishes; read-side final check and cleaning-version invalidation also missing. Production-entry fixture tests fail.
Global captions become false chunk signals: All table captions are assigned to every chunk in the document; GB8978 all24 chunks acquire Table6 while raw text only one explicitly mentions it.

Prose expansion does not return enumerated evidence: Prose path discards UnitText bodies and no item extraction or verified citations are returned; requested scope must be externally supplied. Benchmark cannot validate enum set correctness.
Synonym alternatives become adjacency: Alternatives flattened into QueryToken tuple use phrase adjacency rather than OR; OOV terms lose their controlled synonym opportunity.
Probe validates query against itself: tokens_text default query mode is compared with query_terms; an intentionally incompatible index stream is undetected.

Metrics lack correct budget and approval semantics: Hits are computed before top-k slicing, rejected gold is counted, and catalog code hits are treated as recall without target evidence; gold contains incorrect column/condition values.
